## About this dashboard
Dispensing practices play a unique role in the NHS by both prescribing and dispensing medicines, which requires robust monitoring to ensure compliance and financial accuracy. The Dispensing Doctor Report in ePACT2 provides authorised users with detailed insights into prescribing and dispensing activity at practice level.

This report enables practices to review the volume and cost of items dispensed, identify trends, and assess profitability. It includes data on top items by volume and cost, personally administered items, and specialist drugs, supporting practices in managing stock levels and optimising procurement. Users can filter data by time period and therapeutic category, making it a valuable tool for operational and financial planning.

The aim of this report is to promote transparency and accountability in dispensing practice operations. It helps practices identify areas for improvement, validate claims, and ensure compliance with NHS reimbursement rules. While the report provides detailed financial and prescribing data, it should be used alongside other dashboards and clinical guidance to inform decisions. Its intention is to support medicines optimisation, improve efficiency, and maintain high standards of patient care.
